change_log.claim_text: Control-plane architecture and governed agentic AI platform ownership.
Distributed infrastructure supporting enterprise platform deployment.
Enterprise adoption and commercial growth orientation.
Productization, reusable IP, and commercialization leadership.
Repeatable delivery from development through production.
Dependable governed operation for regulated AI workflows.

claim_ledger.claim_text: Owned Unify Consulting's mandate to make governed agentic AI a durable enterprise growth engine, linking control-plane architecture, an industrialized delivery model, and alliance distribution so regulated clients could adopt dependable capabilities that evolved from bespoke engagements into productized IP and scalable platform services.

- bul_unify_001: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows through deterministic route-policy dispatch and multi-agent orchestration contracts.
- bul_unify_002: Expanded enterprise AI platform adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions, connecting workflow value to reusable commercialization and usage-based forecasting.
- bul_unify_003: Strengthened production trust with audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows, supported by evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls.
- bul_unify_004: Accelerated the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks by standardizing managed workflow orchestration from intake through production monitoring.
- bul_unify_005: Built high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across AWS and Databricks Lakehouse data infrastructure supporting vector services and parallel decision workflows.
- bul_unify_006: Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a repeatable operating model.
